title: record page: while it loads, the breadcrumb and title show the internal id (#xxxxxxxx) and related-list counts show 0 (split from #35476 item 4)
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5krBqrrgxCYgjXmfbv

Filing gate ④ · Source: fleet · split from objectstack-ai/objectstack#35476 item 4 (coordinator child of epic #34571, maintainer-directed 2026-11-19). Items 1–3 of #35476 are superseded by #36112 (top bar removed; PR A #36187 merged); item 5 is cloud-lane. Item 4 is still live and is record-page work, not shell work, so it moves here.

## What happens
While a record page loads, the breadcrumb and title show the record's internal id (`#${shortId}` in `RecordDetailView.tsx` / `recordDrawerStack.tsx`) until the record arrives, and related-list count badges show 0 before their counts load. On a slow network a user reads 「#8e25d44e…」 and 「0」 for a moment (seen on cloud staging 2026-11-19, per #35476).

## Done when
- During load, breadcrumb and title show a skeleton or the object label, never an internal id.
- A related-list count badge shows nothing (or a skeleton) until its count loads, never 0.
- Pins: a slow-loading record page asserts no `#`-prefixed id in breadcrumb/title before load; a related list asserts no 0 badge before its count resolves; an ablation each.

reach: every record page (full page and drawer stack), by code reading on main (a4-H, 2026-11-22); to be measured once by the claimant.
Business reason: users see a meaningless code and a false "0 related records" on every slow load.
Reader: a domain:ui lane (record page). `RecordDetailView.tsx` is being edited by #36147 — sequence after it.
Blocked-by: #36147
Dedupe: `breadcrumb internal id loading record page`, `shortId breadcrumb` → only #35476.
Grade: p2 (inherits #35476's grade).
